title: Spudlight — Developed Source / Channel / Storage / Observer Theory
status: project archaeology + developed typed systems theory; no new fundamental field established
abstract: Spudlight becomes scientifically valuable when it is treated as a general architecture of transmission and transformation rather than as a single substance that is simultaneously light, attention, meaning, energy and revelation. This redevelopment makes that architecture explicit. A source generates a typed signal; a channel filters or distorts it; a storage state integrates past input; an observer performs inference; and a Door-like decision rule converts inference into action or state transition. The same causal skeleton can be instantiated in optics, plant carbon storage, communications or social attention while each domain retains its own variables, units and governing laws. The theory adds continuous-time state-space equations, transfer functions, passivity and conservation tests, observability/identifiability conditions, information bottleneck structure, delayed release kernels and a separation between energy flow and information gain. Starchforce is retained as the storage/release branch, not a fifth force. The project-specific contribution is therefore a reusable source→channel→storage→observer→decision grammar whose scientific value is measured by whether it predicts real state transitions better than simpler domain-specific baselines. The framework is T2 as systems theory and T0 as a novel fundamental physical interaction.
research_question: Can one typed source-channel-storage-observer architecture improve prediction and control across specific domains without falsely identifying energy, information, attention and symbolic meaning as the same quantity?

master_state_space.meaning: Spudlight is represented by the full causal architecture, not by any one variable x, y or u

typed_layers.information: statistical dependence, posterior change or channel capacity measured in bits/nats where appropriate
typed_layers.attention_social: behavioral/network observables such as exposure, engagement or centrality
typed_layers.symbolic_theological: project meaning layer with no automatic conversion into physical units
typed_layers.rule: cross-layer mappings must be explicit functions or statistical models

physical_light_branch.photon_rate: Ndot approximately P/(h nu) for narrowband light
physical_light_branch.meaning: reflection, absorption and mediation become measurable transfer functions rather than moral or metaphysical properties

starchforce_storage_branch.release_fraction_isolated: With J_in=0, total released fraction to the useful output channel is eta/(eta+Gamma)
starchforce_storage_branch.cutoff: omega_c=eta+Gamma for the first-order linear store
starchforce_storage_branch.meaning: storage is a low-pass memory: fast input fluctuations are smoothed while slow changes accumulate

delayed_release_extension.meaning: release may depend on stored history rather than only the instantaneous stock
delayed_release_extension.identifiability: a flexible memory kernel can overfit; constrain or regularize kappa and compare against the one-state exponential baseline

conservation_and_passivity.positivity: for nonnegative initial stock and nonnegative physical fluxes, a valid stock model should not create negative K without an explicit signed interpretation
conservation_and_passivity.passivity_idea: stored energy cannot exceed supplied energy minus accounted losses in an isolated physical implementation
conservation_and_passivity.failure: a physical Starchforce model is invalid if its bookkeeping creates energy/material from nowhere

information_branch.capacity: C=max_p(x) I(X;Y) subject to input constraints
information_branch.boundary: information gain is dimensionless/statistical and is not joules of physical light

information_bottleneck.meaning: a useful mediator discards irrelevant source variation while retaining information needed for the target
information_bottleneck.project_translation: revelation can be operationalized as selective preservation of task-relevant information, not as maximum raw signal volume

observer_and_eye.observability_linear: O=[C;CA;CA^2;...;CA^(n-1)] has full rank for complete state observability in an n-dimensional LTI system
observer_and_eye.meaning: the Eye can infer hidden state only if the observation process contains enough information
observer_and_eye.identifiability_warning: source, channel and noise cannot generally all be inferred uniquely from one output stream without calibration or interventions

door_decision_layer.meaning: signal becomes consequential only after a receiver estimates a state and a policy/threshold converts it into action
door_decision_layer.research_test: does adding the proposed Spudlight signal improve transition prediction beyond a model using ordinary covariates alone?

plant_carbon_instantiation.chain: solar radiation -> photosynthetic assimilation -> transport -> starch/tuber storage -> remobilization/respiration/growth
plant_carbon_instantiation.prediction: lagged light/assimilation should predict storage changes only after respiration, phenology, source-sink and environmental covariates are accounted for
plant_carbon_instantiation.boundary: the poetic phrase 'sunlight hidden in matter' maps to measurable chemical free-energy/carbon storage only in this typed sense

social_attention_instantiation.meaning: attention can behave like a leaky integrator without being physical light
social_attention_instantiation.baseline: compare against recency, network and content-only models before attributing extra explanatory value to the Spudlight architecture

dimensionless_cross_domain_question.goal: look for shared normalized dynamics only after each domain is independently calibrated
dimensionless_cross_domain_question.example: rescale time by tau and stock by K_inf so the linear store obeys dk/dtheta=1-k under constant input
dimensionless_cross_domain_question.value: dimensionless forms may reveal structural similarity without claiming shared substance
dimensionless_cross_domain_question.boundary: shared mathematical form is analogy unless a physical derivation connects the domains

failure_conditions: A physical Spudlight effect disappears once ordinary optical/thermal/biological mechanisms are modeled.
A storage model violates conservation or fails held-out stock/release trajectories.
An information model is non-identifiable and does not improve predictive likelihood or decisions.
A social-attention model adds no predictive value beyond exposure/network/content baselines.
Cross-domain unification is rejected as physical if only the notation is shared and no common dimensionless law/derivation survives testing.
next_decisive_work: Choose one flagship empirical domain rather than fitting all domains at once.
Estimate the minimal linear source-channel-storage model and verify conservation/identifiability.
Add nonlinearity or memory only when residual structure demands it.
Measure whether the observer/decision layer improves transition prediction.
Compare dimensionless fitted dynamics across domains only after each model passes independently.
